Merge → split round-trip for inputs/merge_dir/part_{a,b,c}.osm.

These three files were written by the lanelet2 OSM writer (not JOSM), have
positive ids, and include areas (part_a) and regulatory elements (part_c).

Result (this case, also_compare in case.json): byte-identical reconstruction
of all three parts. file_origin / original_id / git tags are stripped on
split as designed.

Not true in general — see ../../README.md (JOSM formatting, negative ids
positivised, area outer-ring rotation on a full mapping_example merge/split).
